declares: The capital fleet's declared comparison sets, promoted from the fleet SPEC so a page reads the set structurally rather than from identity prose. Row order is the declared order and is part of the declaration. Roles: subject / comparison / domestic-control (holders); adviser-subject / adviser-comparison (adviser mandates). A declared member the fleet has no entity for is listed with id null and resolved false, and has no claims.
declaration:
- Holders: BlackRock is never recorded alone. The comparison set is Vanguard, Norges Bank
  Investment Management (Government Pension Fund Global — publishes every holding with %:
  `nbim.no`), GIC (Government of Singapore), Capital Group (EuroPacific Growth Fund),
  Fidelity, and LIC as the domestic control. Same fields for each.
- Advisers: Rothschild & Co against Lazard, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan, Citi,
  Kotak, Axis Capital, Avendus — same mandate fields (client, deal, role, date, fee where
  disclosed).

rows.label: The Vanguard Group, Inc.
rows.note: The SPEC's Controls section lists Vanguard first in BlackRock's comparison set; it is a subject here because the SPEC's question calibrates the narrative 'BlackRock and Vanguard own India' (FINANCE_PAGE.md F15, D22).

rows.label: Norges Bank Investment Management (Government Pension Fund Global)
Government of Singapore / GIC Private Limited
Capital Group Companies, Inc.
rows.note: The SPEC names Capital Group with its EuroPacific Growth Fund.

rows.note: Declared "LIC as the domestic control"; LIC is the sole promoter of Axis Bank, a different relationship from its holdings elsewhere (holders-b1:c008).

rows.note: The SPEC's rule: 'Rothschild' is Rothschild & Co and its Indian subsidiary, identified by LEI/CIN — two ids, never merged.

rows.label: JP Morgan
rows.note: No entity in mandates-ventures.json. cap:jpmorgan-chase-bank-na-adr-depositary (holders-b9) is JPMorgan Chase Bank acting as ADR depositary — a different role and entity, not merged by name.

rows.label: Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited
rows.note: The fleet records Kotak's adviser role on the listed bank's id (mandates-ventures.json publicRole 'Listed bank; control-set adviser'); no separate id for Kotak Mahindra Capital.

rows.label: Axis Capital
